script_text: Taurus, the universe is shifting the tectonic plates of your life — don't look away. Monday brings a harsh Mars square to Saturn in your 6th House, grinding productivity to a halt. Through Wednesday, the tension lingers, but a Venus trine with the Sun eases it by midweek. Thursday is where everything pivots — Venus trines Neptune in your 7th House of Partnerships, rewriting your Earth-sign love story. Saturday's Sun sextile Jupiter in your 10th House lights up career momentum and a money opportunity. The weekend Moon in Cancer wraps you in emotional safety and quiet reflection. Wednesday is your best day because Venus trines the Sun, boosting creativity and romantic confidence. Monday is your worst day because Mars squares Saturn in your 6th House, flooding you with frustration. Lean into the Thursday energy where Venus trines Neptune for love and trust the weekend for career clarity. Follow for daily updates.
